en.name: Dev Desk
en.summary: Three commands, one staff-engineer agent and a prompt shelf for planning, reviewing and shipping.
en.readme:
## What it adds

Dev Desk is a small extension pack for day-to-day software work. It contributes:

- **Commands** — `/plan`, `/review`, `/ship`.
- **Agent preset** — **Staff Engineer**, an agent that plans before it edits and keeps changes small.
- **Prompts** — a shelf of reusable asks: threat model, migration plan, test matrix, rollback plan.
- **Setting** — review depth (`light`, `balanced`, `deep`).

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/plan` | Turns a request into a scoped plan with risks, files and verification steps. |
| `/review` | Reviews the current diff with blocking and non-blocking findings. |
| `/ship` | Produces a release checklist, then a release note draft. |

## Design choices

- Nothing runs automatically. Every command is an explicit invocation.
- The agent preset has no shell access by default; you can grant it per workspace.
- Prompts are plain text you can edit after installing.

## What it does not do

- It does not install MCP servers or credentials.
- It does not change your global tool policy.
- It does not phone home.

## Permissions

Only contributes UI commands, an agent preset, prompts and one setting. No file, network or shell access is granted by the pack itself.

pt.name: Dev Desk
pt.summary: Três comandos, um agente staff engineer e uma prateleira de prompts para planejar, revisar e lançar.
pt.readme:
## O que adiciona

Dev Desk é um pacote pequeno para o dia a dia de software. Ele contribui com:

- **Comandos** — `/plan`, `/review`, `/ship`.
- **Agente** — **Staff Engineer**, um agente que planeja antes de editar e mantém mudanças pequenas.
- **Prompts** — uma prateleira reutilizável: threat model, plano de migração, matriz de testes, plano de rollback.
- **Configuração** — profundidade de revisão (`light`, `balanced`, `deep`).

## Comandos

| Comando | O que faz |
|---|---|
| `/plan` | Transforma um pedido em plano com escopo, riscos, arquivos e passos de verificação. |
| `/review` | Revisa o diff atual com achados bloqueantes e não bloqueantes. |
| `/ship` | Monta um checklist de release e um rascunho de notas de versão. |

## Decisões de projeto

- Nada roda automaticamente. Todo comando é uma invocação explícita.
- O agente não tem acesso a shell por padrão; você pode conceder por workspace.
- Prompts são texto simples, editável depois da instalação.

## O que ele não faz

- Não instala servidores MCP nem credenciais.
- Não altera sua política global de ferramentas.
- Não envia dados para fora.

## Permissões

Apenas contribui comandos de interface, um agente, prompts e uma configuração. O pacote em si não concede acesso a arquivos, rede ou shell.

commands.prompt: Read the request and the relevant files first. Produce a plan with: goal, non-goals, files to touch, risks, verification steps, and the smallest first change. Do not edit anything yet.
Review the current git diff. Return: verdict, blocking findings with file:line and a failure scenario, non-blocking notes, and missing tests. Do not modify the code.
Prepare a release checklist for the current branch: version bump, changelog, migration notes, rollback plan, and a draft of user-facing release notes. Ask before changing any file.

description.en: Plans first, keeps diffs small, verifies before claiming done.
description.pt: Planeja primeiro, mantém diffs pequenos e verifica antes de dizer que terminou.

agents.instructions: You are a staff engineer. Read before writing. Prefer the smallest change that solves the problem. State assumptions. Verify with the project's own tests or commands. Report what you did, what you did not do, and what remains uncertain. Never claim success without evidence.

prompts.body: Act as a security reviewer. List assets, entry points, trust boundaries, likely abuse cases and the cheapest mitigation for each. Be concrete about this repository.
Produce a migration plan: current shape, target shape, ordered steps, data backfill, dual-read/write window, rollback, and how to verify each step.
List the behaviours that changed and the smallest set of tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) that would catch regressions. Include the sad paths.
Write the rollback plan for this change: trigger conditions, exact steps, data implications, and what monitoring confirms recovery.

description.en: How far the review looks beyond the changed lines.
description.pt: O quanto a revisão olha além das linhas alteradas.
